Start date: 1207-09-03 (YYYY-MM-DD).  
20 weeks = 140 days.  
Add 5 days → total subtract 145 days.  

1207 is not a leap year (divisible by 4 but also by 100 and not by 400).  
September 3 minus 145 days:  
Go back into August: 3 days into Sept → Aug 31 (3 days back).  
Remaining 142 days earlier.  
August has 31 days, July 31, June 30, May 31, April 30, March 31, February 28 (non-leap).  

Count back:  
Aug: 31 days (from Aug 31) → back to Aug 1 uses 30 days, remaining 112.  
July: 31 days → remaining 81.  
June: 30 days → remaining 51.  
May: 31 days → remaining 20.  
April: 30 days → go back 20 days into April: April 30 back 20 days = April 10.  

FINAL_ANSWER: 1207-04-10
